subject: Re: MultimodalChat kickoff — June status, one label-noise risk
body:
Hi both,

Status ahead of the end-of-June baseline milestone:

- Share-intent model: F1 0.58 on predicting the share_photo turn, vs 0.41 for a recency heuristic. Turns where share_photo is true have empty message text, which makes the supervision clean.
- Retrieval: Hyun and Carmen's dual-encoder hits Recall@1 of 0.34 / Recall@5 of 0.62 against the ~10k photo pool. Index and serving path are up (thanks Amara — June crunch is paying off).

Risk: photo_description quality. The object labels are coarse ("dog, grass, frisbee"), and Efe's first human-judged pass shows ~15% of top-1 retrievals are label-matched but contextually wrong. Options: enrich descriptions with a captioner before indexing (Amara estimates 1 week of index rebuild), or accept and message it as v1 quality. We need a call by 06-26 to hold the demo date.

Yara
